The first issue of EADM's revived newsletter. The board plans to publish
it every June and December to keep members up to date between SPUDM
meetings. In this issue:

1. Introducing EADM's revived newsletter
2. SPUDM 2023 Vienna, Austria
3. SPUDM 2025 Lucca, Italy
4. EADM open vacancies
5. EADM Summer School 2024
6. EGPROC 2024
7. Funding available, please apply!
8. Update on publishing at JDM
9. EADM's new code of conduct
10. Updating EADM's bylaws – your input needed
